description: This PHP file defines the 'Viewpackage' class which extends 'SugarView' and manages the display and logic related to package management in the ModuleBuilder of SuiteCRM. It handles rendering package lists, loading package details, initializing module types, and generating package buttons in the user interface.

classes.name: Viewpackage
classes.description: A class extending SugarView to manage package views within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder, including rendering package lists, details, and UI controls.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameters, including translated module name and module title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to handle the display logic for the package view, including rendering package lists or package details based on request parameters.

methods.name: loadModuleTypes
methods.description: Loads the module types associated with the current package.

methods.name: loadPackageHelp
methods.description: Sets help information for the package, defaulting to create or modify states.

methods.name: generatePackageButtons
methods.description: Generates UI buttons for available packages, including a 'new package' button.
